description: The ERIES research team publishes experimental response data for base-plate connections in a substandard steel frame. Tests at the University of Patras Structures Laboratory include free vibration, cyclic loading and pseudo-dynamic excitation of semi-rigid, partial-strength column bases. Zenodo hosts the associated archives and text documentation free under CC BY 4.0. The collection can calibrate connection stiffness, degradation and seismic-response assumptions in structural simulations. It is a site-specific laboratory campaign, not a survey of damaged buildings or a continuous field-monitoring series. Transfer to other frame designs requires matching geometry, material properties and loading conditions. The repository identifies the experimental package but does not establish every internal file format in its top-level metadata. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
name: Biaxial seismic response of base-column connections in sub-standard steel buildings: dataset
